_comment: Tier-2 for dealii hyperelasticity#9. GridGenerator::subdivided_hyper_rectangle called WITHOUT colorize gives every face boundary_id 0, so a clamp written for one face takes the whole boundary with it. Measured on an 8x8 unit square with a shear traction on the face the user meant to leave free: with colorize=false the distinct boundary ids are {0}, all 32 boundary faces carry id 0, interpolate_boundary_values on id 0 constrains all 64 boundary dofs, and the loaded solve returns a displacement whose infinity norm is exactly 0 -- the Newton loop reports convergence in 0 steps because there is nothing left to solve. That is the claim's 'DataOut shows displacement field zero everywhere', reproduced. With colorize=true the ids are {0,1,2,3}, only 8 faces carry id 0, 18 of the 64 boundary dofs are constrained, and the same load produces a displacement of 0.0268. This fixture replaces a legacy compile_and_run one that the evidence driver could not run at all (rc=99) and whose expectations were the bare substrings 'boundary_id' and 'GridGenerator', which any echo of the source would satisfy and which no mutation could lose. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. No expectation depends on wall-clock time.
